title: Automated guided vehicle, frames made in China, completed in South Korea
description: A battery-plant vehicle: the chassis and lifting frame are cut and welded in China, then the drive, sensors and software are completed in South Korea. CBP held China (N336445): the frames decide.
source: CBP rulings N336445 (5 Dec 2023) and N337718 (2024), rulings.cbp.gov
notes: One of the six families added in D660 (off-road vehicles and mobile machinery). Built from CBP's facts into a development fixture: where the drive parts are made is not stated, so the fixture files them under the Korean plant; plant capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. Both rulings are excluded from precedent search. Picked by family, not by result. Recorded development run (eval/results/plan-roll-agv-2023-local-verifier-v2-d660-litellm.json): the engine said South Korea at 0.82 stated where CBP held China, so this card disagrees with CBP. The shown plan moves the chassis and working frames to South Korea, check 0.96 on N334276; that ruling held Poland for scissor lifts with two structural subassemblies made there, so it supports the move by analogy. Backtest: CBP held South Korea in N337718 when the handling frame and roll tray were Korean, but the plan's single working-frame move checked only 0.90, below the bar. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: Automated guided vehicle for electrode rolls
product.description: A self-navigating vehicle with a lifting mechanism that raises a feeder assembly to load anode and cathode rolls in a battery plant.

components.name: lower frame assembly (chassis) with drive frame components
upper frame assembly with roller support and shear lifting mechanism
drive assembly, battery, casters and controllers

operations.name: cut, weld and polish metal plates into the chassis and fit the drive frame components
weld tubing, sheets and plates into the upper frame and mount the lifting and roller support mechanisms
install the drive assembly, battery, controllers, cameras, sensors and wiring, join the frames, fit the cover, load software, calibrate and test
